title: sdk: unify auth/retries/streaming ergonomics across python/ts/go; parity fixes & version bumps
author: Ava Martinez
description:
Motivation: We have divergent ergonomics across SDKs for auth, retry policies, and streaming interfaces. This causes user confusion and duplicate docs/bugs. This PR standardizes the surface across Python, TypeScript, and Go SDKs, fixes parity gaps (streaming close/shutdown, metadata propagation), and bumps SDK package versions.

Summary of changes:
- Python: introduce AuthClient abstraction, unified RetryPolicy config (max_retries, backoff_strategy), new streaming client API with context-manager/async context-manager support, improved reconnect/backpressure handling.
- TypeScript: expose same RetryPolicy shape, add streaming iterator helper and stable backpressure semantics, ensure auth token refresh hook is pluggable (AuthProvider).
- Go: add RetryPolicy struct and client-side middleware, streaming API returns a typed channel + Close method, ensure metadata header propagation for trace/span ids.
- All SDKs: align error types/messages for transient vs permanent errors, add consistent telemetry tags, bump package versions (see release_notes).

Files touched: cross-repo SDK changes and docs/quickstarts updated. The description below lists high-level commit summaries and changed files. Migration notes: most users only need to swap retry config keys (old: retries -> new: retry_policy.max_retries) or update import paths for streaming helpers. Backwards compatibility: thin compatibility shims provided in each SDK for one release cycle; these emit deprecation warnings.

Testing & CI: unit + integration tests added for retry backoff behavior and streaming reconnect scenarios. Manual smoke tested against hosted API and dedicated replay harness.

Rollout: merged to main; package releases will be cut in coordinated release job. Consumers should watch for deprecation warnings and migrate before the next major release.

review_comments: Samir Patel: Requested changes around the Python context manager semantics — suggested adding explicit close() on stream objects to avoid relying solely on GC. (addressed in a1f3d2c)
Leah Kim: Asked for explicit telemetry tags for retry attempts and backoff reason. Added in retries modules across SDKs. (addressed in b4c2e9a, c7d5b00)
Owen Zhang: Noted a potential race in Go streaming Close; added tests and a mutex in stream.go to fix. (addressed in c7d5b00)
CI Bot: Integration tests flaky on first run, reran pipeline; subsequent runs passed.
merge_outcome: Merged to main via squash merge after approvals from reviewers. CI green on final run.
release_notes: Python SDK 1.12.0: Introduces AuthClient, unified RetryPolicy (new config keys), context-manager streaming API, deprecation shims for old retry config.
TypeScript SDK 0.9.3: Adds RetryPolicy type, AuthProvider hook, streaming iterator helper, package bump.
Go SDK 0.7.1: Adds RetryPolicy middleware, streaming channel API with Close, metadata propagation fixes.
Migration: Update retry config keys and prefer new streaming helpers. Deprecations will be removed in next major release.
